mission: Route explicit Prompt Kit feedback and privacy-bounded derived Operant friction into bounded AFK development work without giving browser telemetry, transport code, or a local coordinator independent merge authority.

owns: append-only browser-local explicit feedback
explicit user consent for any future private loopback sync
browser-local cursor state
forbidden: implicit historical upload when consent is enabled
raw ordinary-usage export without a separate accepted privacy contract

owns: deriving a coarse friction receipt from deterministic runtime failure or repeated local patterns
keeping raw ordinary usage local and non-actionable
dropping search text, typed content, navigation history, identity, URL, clipboard, and prompt body before AFK routing
forbidden: turning one ordinary click, copy, open, invoke, or favorite event into repository work

owns: loopback request validation
browser-source pseudonymization
private local spool and retry receipts
sanitized provider wakeup metadata when enabled
forbidden: raw written feedback in provider dispatch payloads

owns: single-signal classification
signal-id deduplication
machine-readable work-request creation
bounded invocation of one configured capable worker
privacy-bounded Operant friction receipt admission
extracting only the sanitized repository_dispatch client_payload
delegating one accepted friction receipt to the provider-neutral AFK router
emitting bounded state/work-request/recipe evidence as workflow artifacts
forbidden: provider identity propagation into work-request evidence

allowed_mutation_owners: P32 GNHF Validation and CI Repair

generator.condition: Run after an owned Operant/Prompt Kit source mutation when the generated site can be affected; never repair the generated output instead of its canonical source.

owns: validating one actionable prompt-kit-afk-work-request/v1 input
compiling a deterministic operant-upgrade-recipe/v1 identity from the exact work request
preserving the already-declared P07 or P32 mutation owner rather than inventing a new owner
deriving one deterministic isolated branch name from the exact work-request hash
binding canonical source, generator, validator, and P105 integration instructions without executing promotion
forbidden: raw telemetry collection or friction derivation
inventing a mutation owner not declared by the work request and allowlist
copying raw private feedback text into the portable recipe

execution_adapters.contract: Local workers and remote SCM/CI adapters consume the same sanitized signal/work-request semantics.
execution_adapters.worker_boundary: The worked GitHub adapter invokes the canonical upgrade engine to emit a deterministic recipe. Any other adapter without a configured worker argv stops at BLOCKED_WORKER_UNCONFIGURED and does not claim repository mutation.

proof_levels.static: Contract, registries, source boundaries, and generated-site parity on the tested commit.
proof_levels.upgrade_recipe: Exact work-request hashing and deterministic recipe recompilation prove ownership/scope/generator/validator routing only; execution remains separate.
proof_levels.provider: Observed workflow/check/review identities for the exact candidate only.
proof_levels.browser_runtime: Observed browser request/response and persistence behavior; static JavaScript assertions are insufficient.
proof_levels.promotion: P105/pr-floor exact-head validation and provider merge receipt; never inferred from the AFK router or upgrade recipe.
